0022600175.text: The Bucks (1-6, 14th in the East) visit the Celtics (5-2, 3rd in the East) in their eighth game of the season, carrying a three-game losing streak and a 0-3 road record, while Boston is 4-0 at home and has lost only its most recent game. Milwaukee will be without Kam Jones, who is out with an ankle injury, and Boston will be missing Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Bucks lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 133-101 defeat in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
